description: This Java source file defines the utility class RepositoryUtils, which provides methods for handling entity data queries, filtering, and conversion between different query representations within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: RepositoryUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing methods for entity query conversion, filtering, and comparison within the Thingsboard platform.

methods.name: resolveEntityType
methods.description: Determines the EntityType based on the provided EntityFilter.

methods.name: customerUserIsTryingToAccessTenantEntity
methods.description: Checks if a non-tenant user is attempting to access tenant or system entities.

methods.name: isSystemOrTenantEntity
methods.description: Helper method to identify system or tenant entity types.

methods.name: toNewQuery
methods.description: Converts an EntityDataQuery to an EdqsDataQuery.

methods.name: toNewQuery
methods.description: Converts an EntityCountQuery to an EdqsCountQuery.

methods.name: toKeyFilters
methods.description: Transforms a list of KeyFilter objects into a list of EdqsFilter objects.

methods.name: toNewKey
methods.description: Converts an EntityKey to a DataKey, using a dictionary for ID mapping.

methods.name: toNewKeys
methods.description: Transforms a list of EntityKey objects into a list of DataKey objects.

methods.name: checkKeyFilters
methods.description: Checks if an EntityData object satisfies a list of EdqsFilter key filters.

methods.name: checkKeyFilter
methods.description: Overloaded method to check if a string, double, or boolean value satisfies a KeyFilterPredicate.

methods.name: checkComplexKeyFilter
methods.description: Evaluates complex filter predicates with AND/OR operations.

methods.name: toEntityNameSqlLikePattern
methods.description: Creates a regex Pattern for SQL LIKE pattern matching on entity names.

methods.name: toSqlLikePattern
methods.description: Helper method to generate regex Patterns from SQL LIKE patterns.

methods.name: toTsValue
methods.description: Creates a TsValue from a timestamp and DataPoint.

methods.name: getSortValue
methods.description: Retrieves the DataPoint used for sorting from an EntityData object.

methods.name: checkFilters
methods.description: Checks if an EntityData object matches the filters specified in an EdqsQuery.

methods.name: checkTextSearch
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive text search within entity fields and latest values.
